Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You get a step-by-step guide to course registration. And it is possible to switch courses for a long time into the semester.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The International mobility office is always helpful and answers by mail quickly.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Succesful

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do not stress over the registration.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level of the course was not higher than in Denmark. But since we has to work at a European and International level and had to take into account student from many different countries and cultures, I think it was appropriate.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The style of teaching was different. For example, you are typically evaluated publicly in front of the rest of the class.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Gender Justice
Public, Private Partnership for Sustainable Development
Smart cities, Artificial intelligence and Digital Transformation law
Negotiation, mediation and sustainable conflict resolution
Law, Culture and Development in a global world

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: All of my courses were very good  both teaching and examination method.

questions.answer: Very easy.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The food and the people. Local people are generally very nice towards strangers.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Do not stress over school. It is generally easier to pass a course than it is in Denmark.
